```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

# Load the data (filtered to 2018-2024)
crashes_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/victorian_road_crash_data_2018-2024.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Cleaning (documented in the Methodology section)
# Drop two artefact categories, recode placeholders to NA, type the variables.
crashes <- crashes_raw |>
  filter(
    SEVERITY != "Non injury accident",
    is.na(DTP_REGION) | DTP_REGION != "METROPOLITAN SOUTH EAST REGION"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hour         = as.integer(sub(":.*", "", ACCIDENT_TIME)),
    SPEED_ZONE   = SPEED_ZONE |> as.character() |> na_if("Not known") |> as.integer(),
    young_driver = YOUNG_DRIVER_18_25 > 0,
    SEVERITY = factor(
      SEVERITY,
      levels = c("Fatal accident", "Serious injury accident", "Other injury accident"),
      labels = c("Fatal", "Serious injury", "Other injury"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

# Sanity check for errors
stopifnot(nrow(crashes) == 99325L)

# Values used inline
n_crashes <- nrow(crashes)
yd_rate   <- round(mean(crashes$young_driver) * 100, 1)
```
